evidence: Base ctor 0x0028EA34, resets lifetime counter, spawns sprite via Gfx_CreateSpriteFromTemplate (0x00471DF4).

name: Gfx_SpriteNode_TickLifetime
summary: Per-frame sprite lifetime tick: decreases the remaining time, clamps it to the configured minimum and despawns/respawns the sprite when it expires.
evidence: Per-frame sprite tick calling maybe_Field_SceneNode_TickChildren (0x005F7F30); manages lifetime expiration.

name: Gfx_SpriteNode_Release
summary: Releases a sprite node: runs the base destructor and then calls vtable slot +0x18 (stop) on the attached effect handle.
evidence: Runs base destructor 0x0028EA34 and stops attached effect handle via virtual call.

name: maybe_Ui_Window_FinishCloseTransition
summary: Tells the window's transition child (+0x4c) to jump straight to its finished state and reports 0 so the caller knows no further work is needed. Appears to be the 'snap to end' half of the open/close animation.
evidence: Slot 1 in vtable 0x007735EC whose slot 0 is Ui_Window_LayoutRows; triggers finish on transition child.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpriteNode_EmitBurst_Tail
summary: Continuation block of the sprite-burst spawner: stores the freshly created effect node at +0x2f4 and returns; the following block is the retry path that re-plays the spawn animation when the requested effect id is not loaded yet. Ghidra split this tail off the main body.
evidence: Continuation block/tail split of sprite burst spawner at 0x0047298C; restores registers and exits.

name: Ui_Pane_UpdateFlaggedVisibility
summary: Shows or hides a pane according to a small flag record and, when the pane becomes active, marks every child in its list as visible.
evidence: Updates visibility of pane according to 4-byte flag struct; calls func_003E043C.

name: Ui_Window_BindChildLayoutBlocksB
signature: void Ui_Window_BindChildLayoutBlocksB(UiWindow* self, u32* rowData, u32 ctxA, u32 ctxB)
summary: Same child-layout rebinding loop as 0x451058 but for a window whose child list hangs directly at self+4; visible non-sentinel children get their layout block re-resolved.

name: Ui_Window_BindAnimCallbackA

name: Ui_SlotGrid_UpdateCrossFade
summary: Per-frame update of the 4x4 slot grid: releases finished slot animations and drives the two-step cross-fade that moves the highlight from one column to the next.
evidence: Called by 0x004111FC in Ui_ItemWindow; updates cross-fade transparency on slot grid.

name: Ui_SlotGrid_MoveHighlight
signature: void Ui_SlotGrid_MoveHighlight(UiSlotGrid* self, unsigned char* columns)
summary: Re-targets the highlight of each of the four grid rows: determines which of the four columns currently holds the row's id and starts the cross-fade animation towards it.
evidence: Moves highlight selection cursor across slot grid cells and updates pane state.

name: Ui_Window_BindAnimCallbackB
signature: void Ui_Window_BindAnimCallbackB(UiAnimBinding* binding, UiOwner* owner, const AnimRef*

name: maybe_Ui_AnimRef_UpdateVariantState
summary: Refreshes a bound layout animation reference: stops the attached object, then re-enables it only when the owning widget's variant (self+0x49, <5) has a part defined in the table at 0x72D430 and the widget is active. The part index selects one of four sub-objects whose animation frame is then re-applied.

name: maybe_Ui_List_GetSelectionIndex
summary: Returns the list's selection count, or -1 when the list has no selectable entries.
evidence: Returns current list selection index from list model.

name: Gfx_AnimSequence_ApplyFramesA
summary: Applies one animation variant to a widget that drives two anim channels: sets both channels through vtable+0x60/+0x64 (mode 4), then applies the frame window and the playback range to the main actor. The A..E variants differ only in the channel mode and frame constants.
evidence: Applies animation sequence frames variant A to two-channel widget via virtual methods.

name: Gfx_AnimSequence_ApplyFramesB
summary: Animation-variant application for channel mode 2; applies a fixed frame 0xF to the second channel instead of the caller's variant.
evidence: Applies animation sequence frames variant B to two-channel widget via virtual methods.

name: Gfx_AnimSequence_ApplyFramesC
summary: Animation-variant application for channel mode 0 (the neutral/idle channel).
evidence: Applies animation sequence frames variant C to two-channel widget via virtual methods.

name: Gfx_AnimSequence_ApplyFramesD
summary: Animation-variant setup that also mirrors the four low bits of the channel result into the enabled flag of four sibling sub-objects (+0x44 bit 0), i.e. it shows exactly the parts that the selected animation uses.
evidence: Applies animation sequence frames variant D to two-channel widget via virtual methods.

name: Gfx_AnimSequence_ApplyFramesE
summary: Applies two animation variants in one call (channels 0 and 1) - the composite variant used when a widget animates two parts at once.
evidence: Applies animation sequence frames variant E to two-channel widget via virtual methods.

name: Ui_CompareRow_ClearValue

name: Ui_CompareRow_ApplyState

name: Actor_Action_DragonJumpMUpEnd_Update
summary: Continuation of the 'M Up End' segment: counts the ticks down, keeps the vertical speed inside the remaining height, moves the actor along the horizontal velocity plus the vertical component, and requests state 8 when the timer expires.
evidence: Continuation of dragon jump M Up End state; moves actor and transitions to state 8 on timer expiry.

name: Actor_Action_DragonJump_QueueEndState
summary: Jump segment that queues the landing state: when its tick budget expires it appends state id 8 to the action's pending-state array (self+0x40, count self+0x48) unless it is already queued; meanwhile it moves the actor and recomputes the vertical speed so the landing height is exact.
evidence: Jump segment queuing state 8 into pending-state array on landing.

name: Ui_TextListWidget_Ctor
